# Annotation-Aware ChIP-seq

## Objective

Use genome annotations to create binding or histone-mark peaks and matched input/ChIP libraries with explicit truth.

```r
library(simitall)

simulate_chipseq(
  genome_fa = "results/genome/simulated.fa",
  annotation_gff3 = "results/annotation/genome.gff3",
  out_prefix = "results/chipseq/tf_demo",
  assay_type = "TF",
  biological_replicates = 3,
  n_reads = 1000000,
  conditions = c("control", "stress"),
  seed = 606
)
plot_chipseq_results(
  chip_prefix = "results/chipseq/tf_demo",
  out_prefix = "results/figures/chipseq"
)
```

## Report

Record target type, feature-selection rules, fragment/read model, control libraries, replicate design, peak truth, and condition-specific effects.
